answer:
The ACC/AHA 2023 Hypertension Guideline recommends a blood pressure target of **<130/80 mmHg** for most adults with hypertension [ACC/AHA, 2023]. First-line treatment options include thiazide diuretics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, and calcium channel blockers. This recommendation applies broadly to adults without specific comorbidities or contraindications. 

**Disclaimer:** This guidance is for clinical decision-support and requires professional review. Always confirm with up-to-date local protocols or patient-specific factors. 

[ACC/AHA, 2023]
